proposition: Ibn Turka's disciple Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī held a parallel evolutionary scheme: Quran, then the twelve Arabic sciences, then the age of the Seal of Sainthood whose potential for universal knowledge is unactualized until the present.

mediation.who: Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī, Ḥulal-i Muṭarraz, as summarized by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: a later reader's summary, not Ibn Turka's own words
